description_zh: 调用UpdateControlPolicy修改自定义管控策略
name: UpdateControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the control policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters long. It must start with a letter and can contain only letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: new_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters long. It must start with a letter and can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: new_description

parameters.help_en:
The new policy document.

The policy document can be up to 4,096 characters long.

For more information about the control policy language, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html.

For policy examples, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html。

管控策略示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.name: new_policy_document

ControlPolicy.description_en: The details of the control policy

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of entities to which the control policy is attached
AttachmentCount.description_zh: 管控策略被引用的次数

ControlPolicyType.title_en: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略
ControlPolicyType.title_zh: 管控策略的类型，取值： ● CONTROL_POLICY：管控策略 ● RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY：资源管控策略

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was created

Description.description_en: The description of the control policy

EffectScope.description_en:
The scope of the control policy. Valid values:

All: The control policy applies to Alibaba Cloud accounts, RAM users, and RAM roles.

RAM: The control policy applies only to RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

System: A system control policy.

Custom: A custom control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was last updated
